summary: Event of the server party system: two parties became one. Created on a fresh event entity by bg3.exe+0x2BBFD20 (party regrouping step of esv::party::PartySystem) from a list of 16-byte (party, other party) pairs whenever the second party is a valid entity (otherwise a PartySplitEvent is made). Read by esv::FlagManager::OnPartyMergedEvent (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x852610), which turns both members into Guids and re-broadcasts the party flags; also listed in esv::party::DataSystem views. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (server row; the registry does not flag it one-frame).

fields.name: Party
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2BC4390 (AllocRaw 0x10) sets both qwords to 0xffc0000000000000 (null EntityHandle). Writer bg3.exe+0x2BBFD20 line 260: *ev = pair.first. Toolkit esv::FlagManager::OnPartyMergedEvent: FUN_1802b45e0(world, *param_3) -> Guid -> ls::Guid::ToFS; flags whose owner equals this Guid are the ones moved, so this is the party that went away (direction inferred, see open questions).

fields.name: MergedInto
fields.evidence: Writer bg3.exe+0x2BBFD20 lines 251-261: taken only when pair.second passes the entity-type check (< 0x41) and is not null, then ev[1] = pair.second. OnPartyMergedEvent resolves it to a Guid as well (FUN_1802b45e0(world, param_3[1])).

open_questions: Which of the two parties survives is inferred from esv::FlagManager::OnPartyMergedEvent comparing flag owners with the Guid of member 0; the names Party / MergedInto may be swapped.
